sentence: This project studies how a histone methyltransferase enzyme contributes to tumorigenesis in cancer.
This project tests whether personalized vaccines aimed at cryptic antigens can strengthen the immune response against high grade serous ovarian cancer.
This project builds nanobody-directed, bispecific and inducible immune cells to treat acute myeloid leukemia.
This project tries to find out which microbial changes lead periodontitis to progress or stay stable.
This project studies how weather and population density drive the timing and size of seasonal influenza outbreaks, using modeling and statistics.
This project tests whether neutrophils engineered inside the body with chimeric antigen receptors can reshape the brain tumor microenvironment and target glioblastoma.
This project studies how immune cells and blood proteins change in people with peanut allergy treated with peanut oral immunotherapy or omalizumab.
This project builds an MRI method that measures brain iron in newborns despite motion.
This project coordinates and oversees the activities of a skin disease research center.
This project collects detailed information from a group of endometrial cancer survivors to understand their survivorship.
This project studies postmortem brains of cases and controls to find pathways linked to posttraumatic stress disorder and depression.
This project uses patient derived models of colorectal cancer to study the minimal residual disease that leads to recurrence and metastasis.
This project studies how a compound with broad anticancer activities works and improves it to find a lead compound.
This project provides biospecimen and imaging resources for studies of fibroinflammatory responses in gastrointestinal tissues.
This project studies immune responses in rhesus monkeys to find ways to prevent congenital cytomegalovirus transmission and disease.
This project builds a software toolkit that simulates X-ray and computed tomography cancer imaging for testing imaging technologies.
This project uses MRI to map how brain circuits change over time in people with Huntington's Disease.
This project studies how topoisomerase II controls the development of social behavior in zebrafish and mouse.
This project provides mass spectrometry and proteomics services to measure proteins in visual system tissues.
This project trains neural network models to find out how the brain combines words, using large brain imaging datasets.
